Two restrained rounded bowls use 0’s five-pixel wall and narrow body, with an open left edge and slightly larger lower bowl instead of copying a candidate face.
The square top and upright match 4’s workmanlike terminals; the lower bowl repeats 0’s narrow, near-vertical sides and five-pixel wall.
The lower counter shares 0’s five-pixel ring and restrained straight-sided oval; the upper return is open and compact, inferred without an observed 6.
Two closed counters extend 0’s five-pixel contour; a narrower upper bowl and gently pinched waist avoid a mechanically stacked pair of zeros.
The upper bowl retains 0’s narrow five-pixel ring; a rounded lower return and compact terminal are reconstructed at the same source-pixel weight.
